name: Cyclopoid copepods
description: Predatory copepods. Functional group pooling the three cyclopoid species in the source web - Cyclops varians rubellus, Orthocyclops modestus and Tropocyclops prasinus - following the standard limnological split between herbivorous calanoids and carnivorous cyclopoids; they hunt rotifers and the calanoid Leptodiaptomus, and also eat each other (within-group links not drawn).
